name: create_node_csv_parse_objects
description: Builds a quoted-CSV parser (handles commas and escaped quotes inside fields) consumed by an existing module
prompts: An existing report.js requires parseCsv from a csv module and uses it, but csv.js does not exist yet. Create csv.js exporting parseCsv(text): given CSV text whose first non-empty line is the header row, return an array of objects mapping each header to that row's value. It must correctly handle double-quoted fields: a quoted field may contain commas (which are NOT field separators) and may contain a literal double-quote written as two double-quotes (""), and the surrounding quotes are stripped from the value. Ignore empty lines. You may assume no field contains a newline. Header-only or empty input returns an empty array. Do not modify report.js. Export with module.exports = { parseCsv }.
